inputs.text: [calm] He was a herbivore. [warmly] He munched on ferns, cycads and conifers, near rivers and big swamps. [curious] Other horned dinosaurs lived with him, like Utahceratops.
[nervous] Was there a hunter out there?
[serious] Yes, TEH-rah-toh-FOH-nee-us, a tyrannosaur. [confident] The horns above his eyes could help him defend himself.
